name: Damage Control
caption: First NGOWF World Tag Team Champions, awarded the title by forfeit after Little & Large's Mikey Dobson was jumped backstage.

name: Little & Large
caption: World Tag Team Title tournament finalists; the final itself never happened after Mikey Dobson was jumped backstage, and the title was awarded to Damage Control by forfeit.

name: The Southern Heartbreakers
caption: World Tag Team Title tournament finalists, and (with Bradley Fine) losers of a six-man elimination tag match to The Axis Powers.

name: The Axis Powers
caption: Damian Mazura, Francois Lefebvre and NGOWF Television Champion Lucien Champion -- winners of a six-man elimination tag match over the Southern Heartbreakers and Bradley Fine; the third member (Lucien Champion) is minted separately as a Television Title holder.
